scope: Nine selected issue groups; source-led partial review only.

features.change: Dated references exclude amendments; Adobe Technical Note 5014 date becomes 11 June 1993.
features.assessment: Reference-version constraint, not a new standalone processing operation. Current cmap.rs names 5014 by number/title. doc/errata-read.md already records both changes. This review does not certify every external normative reference or amendment boundary.

features.source: Physical 22/printed 7 and 27/printed 12; struck words checked with bbox.
features.change: Singular boolean object term; object-stream definition explicitly excludes stream objects rather than using the misleading Type spelling.
features.assessment: Terminology and cross-reference corrections. They do not alter the object-stream exclusion already stated in 7.5.7. Do not infer a new mandatory malformed-stream rejection test.

features.change: International-English mitre spelling replaces descriptive miter spelling.
features.assessment: Editorial. Operator M and numeric behavior are unchanged.

features.change: XMP examples use preferred namespace prefixes.
features.assessment: Example convention does not make arbitrary equivalent namespace prefixes invalid. Parent read xmp.rs::a_property_is_its_namespace_uri_and_not_the_prefix_a_file_chose; it asserts the title from a renamed prefix. No new test needed for the note.

features.source: Physical 859/printed 844, BT row in Table A.1.
features.change: Operator catalog reference changes from Table 107 to Table 105, Text object operators.
features.assessment: Cross-reference repair. BT semantics are controlled by 9.4.1; no behavior changes from the catalog title.

features.change: Image Mask typography, viewer-preference page-table references and CropBox typography, and lowercase property list wording.
features.assessment: Parent read all affected primary pages. Existing viewer_preferences.rs defaults/entry tests use literal boundary enums; print_preferences::the_print_pair_decides_the_page_rendered_for_paper distinguishes 400-unit MediaBox from 360-unit default CropBox. associated_file_examples_audit::marked_content_example_interprets_nonempty_text_inside_the_associated_range asserts seven glyphs, an unconditional Hello association range, file identity and checksum. These bounded assertions support the corresponding paths, not all preference or association features.

features.change: Notes point resource users to extra linearization requirements in normative Annex F.
features.assessment: No new requirements beyond Annex F. Existing annex_f_linearization shard retains the optional reader/explicit writer distinction and qualified writer evidence. Parent inspected linearized_cut_chain test: despite its draws name, it asserts page count and xref recovery state, not pixels. It must not be cited as rendering proof. Full resource-placement coverage remains an Annex F residual.
